Hi Rafael,

We ran a usage reconciliation on our pilot account and found ~$21,400 in unredeemed trial/top-up credits from March–April that were never consumed. Our accounting team asked whether Redwood can issue a credit memo to offset the outstanding invoice INV-7893 (due 5/15).

Can you confirm the process and timeline? We need:
- confirmation that credit memo will be issued to offset INV-7893,
- a brief note on how this will appear on our AR aging, and
- any tax documentation you need from us.

Attached: brightleaf_usage_may01.csv (usage export)

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can close our month.

Best,

Tom — thanks for the note and for the usage export. I've looped in Marcus (Finance ops), Mina (Revenue ops) and Laura (Accounting) to confirm the correct pathway. Short answers up-front: yes, we can issue a credit memo and apply it to INV-7893; next steps below.

Proposed path:
1) Finance reviews and signs off on GL mapping for the credit memo (Marcus).
2) We issue a credit memo referencing INV-7893; it will appear as a negative AR line and reduce outstanding balance on your next statement.
3) If you need the credit applied intra-cycle we can do an offline invoice netting entry; otherwise it posts on the next billing run (5/10).

Open items we need from you:
- confirm you want the full $21,400 applied to INV-7893,
- confirm billing contact and PO (if applicable),
- provide any tax exemption certificate if you expect zero tax treatment.

Marcus — can you propose the GL and timing? Laura — assuming standard credit memo, please flag any tax/regulatory considerations. Mina — I’ll update the HubSpot record once we have sign-off.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: unredeemed trial credits + offset to outstanding invoice

Hi all — reviewed the usage file and Rafael's summary. Accounting prefers issuing a formal credit memo that references INV-7893 and posts to AR; this maintains a clear audit trail. Quick notes: 

- GLA mapping: use contra revenue code 4100-CR (promo allowance) with offset to accounts receivable (1200).
- Tax: if Brightleaf is in CA, we will charge tax on the portion of services that were taxable unless we have a tax-exempt certificate on file. If Tom confirms a certificate, we'll set tax to zero on the memo.
- Timing: we can generate the credit memo on 2026-05-10 and apply it to INV-7893 before the due date. If Brightleaf needs immediate netting (same-day reduction), we can process a manual AR adjustment but that requires CFO sign-off.

I've attached a draft credit memo for your review (draft_credit_memo_20260502.pdf) — this is a stub showing line references and the GL. Tom: can you confirm acceptance of the draft and the tax certificate?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
